# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The latest stable release of `@fried-ui/react` and `@fried-ui/styles` receives security updates. Earlier major versions receive fixes only when a CVE is filed against them.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report security issues privately via a GitHub [security advisory](https://github.com/fried-day/fried-ui/security/advisories/new).

Please do not file public issues for security-sensitive bugs. We aim to acknowledge new reports within 48 hours and to ship a coordinated fix in the next release window.
